description: Abort a running Bulk API v2 ingest job -- the recovery lever for a job submitted in error or running against bad data. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the abort taking effect; the Salesforce job's resulting state is delivered when this dispatch's job completes. Records already processed before the abort are NOT rolled back -- check bulk_job_results for what landed.
embedding_description: Stop a bulk load already running before it processes more records -- cancel a mass insert/update/upsert/delete that targeted the wrong CSV, object, or data. Use on a job from bulk_ingest_submit while still in progress; rows already committed are not undone, so check bulk_job_results after. Returns a job_id at once, then the resulting state.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT confirmation the job stopped -- the Salesforce job's resulting state arrives separately, as its own message, when this dispatch's job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the ABORT REQUEST was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the bulk job stopped. Once delivered, confirm the resulting state plainly and remind the user that records processed BEFORE the abort are not rolled back -- point them to bulk_job_results if they need to know exactly what landed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Abort a running Bulk API v2 ingest job in the registered Salesforce org.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing job_id. sf.not_found: no bulk job with that id exists. sf.api_error: the job is already in a terminal state (JobComplete/Failed/Aborted) and cannot be aborted again. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot abort this job.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_found: verify the job_id via bulk_job_status first. sf.api_error naming a terminal-state conflict: the job already finished -- use bulk_job_results to see the outcome instead of retrying the abort. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check bulk API job-management permission for this user.
